## Background

x \<- get_acs_recs("county", table.names=paste("C23002",A:I), years = 2024, acs.type = "acs5") %\>% dplyr::filter(name == "Region")

```{r}
# Population by race/ethnicity
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/psrc/demographic-profile/refs/heads/main/2024/01-pop-by-race-census_categories.R")

# Median household income by race/ethnicity
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/psrc/demographic-profile/refs/heads/main/2024/04-median-hh-income-race.R")

# Poverty rates by race/ethnicity
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/psrc/demographic-profile/refs/heads/main/2024/02-pop-low-income.R")

# Unemployment / labor force participation (16 and over) by gender and race/ethnicity
source("labor_force_unemployment.R")
dt_lf_2024 <- get_regional_acs_labor_force_data(2024)

dt_lf_prepped <- prep_labor_force_data(dt_lf_2024)
lf_p <- plot_lf_rate(dt_lf_prepped, participation_rate, whiskers = TRUE)

dt_unemp_prepped <- prep_unemployment_data(dt_lf_2024)
unemp_p <- plot_lf_rate(dt_unemp_prepped, unemployment_rate, whiskers = TRUE)

```

## Quality of Life

```{r}
# Homeonwnership by race/ethnicity
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/psrc/housing-metrics/refs/heads/main/2026_update/metric05_tenure_by_race_inc.R")

# Renter cost burden by race/ethnicity
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/psrc/housing-metrics/blob/main/2026_update/metric19_cost_burden_by_race_inc.R")

# Internet Access by race/ethnicity
source(internet_access.R)
dt_net <- get_regional_acs_internet_data(2024)
dt_net_prepped <- prep_internet_data(dt_net)

net_access_p <- psrcplot::static_bar_chart(
                    t = dt_net_prepped[internet_status!="dial-up"],
                    y = "race",
                    x = "internet_status_share",
                    fill = "internet_status",
                    title = "Internet Access by Race/Ethnicity",
                    alt = "Chart of Internet Access by Race/Ethnicity",
                    source = paste("Source: ACS 5-Year Estimates, tables B28009A-I",
                                 "for King, Kitsap, Pierce and Snohomish counties.",
                                 sep = "\n"),
                    color="pgnobgy_5", pos = "stack")
```
